author: Veritas I
title: Attention-Enhanced CNN-BiLSTM for RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission introduces a hybrid CNN-BiLSTM architecture enhanced with a Self-Attention Pooling mechanism. A 1D CNN extracts local features, which are then processed by a BiLSTM for long-range dependencies. Self-Attention Pooling is applied to the BiLSTM output to create a context-aware fixed-size representation, aiming to dynamically focus on salient sequence regions and improve overall performance across diverse RNA tasks.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict

# Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class SelfAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    features: int # Output feature dimension after pooling

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        input_features = x.shape[-1]
        
        # Query, Key, Value linear projections
        query = nn.Dense(input_features, name="query_proj")(x)
        key = nn.Dense(input_features, name="key_proj")(x)
        value = nn.Dense(input_features, name="value_proj")(x)

        # Compute attention scores
        # (batch_size, seq_len, input_features) @ (batch_size, input_features, seq_len) -> (batch_size, seq_len, seq_len)
        attention_scores = jnp.matmul(query, jnp.swapaxes(key, -1, -2))
        attention_scores = attention_scores / jnp.sqrt(input_features) # Scale by sqrt(d_k)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_scores, axis=-1)

        # Apply attention weights to values
        # (batch_size, seq_len, seq_len) @ (batch_size, seq_len, input_features) -> (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        context_vector = jnp.matmul(attention_weights, value)

        # Optionally, project the context vector to the desired output features
        pooled_output = jnp.mean(context_vector, axis=1) # (batch_size, input_features)
        
        # Project to final 'features' dimension if different from input_features
        if pooled_output.shape[-1] != self.features:
            pooled_output = nn.Dense(self.features, name="final_proj")(pooled_output)
        
        return pooled_output

# Main network class
class AttentionCNNBiLSTMNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 128
    kernel_size: int = 9
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 256
    attention_features: int = 512 # Output feature dimension of attention pooling
    dense_dim: int = 256
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # 1. CNN Layer for local feature extraction
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, new_seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 3. Self-Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation
        x = SelfAttentionPooling(features=self.attention_features)(x) # (batch, attention_features)
        
        # 4. Dense Layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x) # (batch, dense_dim)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Attention-Enhanced CNN-BiLSTM model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 128,
        'kernel_size': 9,
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 256,
        'attention_features': 512, # Output feature dimension of attention pooling
        'dense_dim': 256,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_AttentionCNNBiLSTM:
    """Custom network wrapper for Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM with Attention."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=128, kernel_size=9,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=256, attention_features=512, dense_dim=256, dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = AttentionCNNBiLSTMNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_features=attention_features,
            dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 128)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 256)
    attention_features = hparams.get("attention_features", 512)
    dense_dim = hparams.get("dense_dim", 256)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_CNNBiLSTM(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_features=attention_features,
        dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict

# Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class SelfAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    features: int # Output feature dimension after pooling

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        input_features = x.shape[-1]

        # Query, Key, Value linear projections
        query = nn.Dense(input_features, name="query_proj")(x)
        key = nn.Dense(input_features, name="key_proj")(x)
        value = nn.Dense(input_features, name="value_proj")(x)

        # Compute attention scores
        # (batch_size, seq_len, input_features) @ (batch_size, input_features, seq_len) -> (batch_size, seq_len, seq_len)
        attention_scores = jnp.matmul(query, jnp.swapaxes(key, -1, -2))
        attention_scores = attention_scores / jnp.sqrt(input_features) # Scale by sqrt(d_k)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_scores, axis=-1)

        # Apply attention weights to values
        # (batch_size, seq_len, seq_len) @ (batch_size, seq_len, input_features) -> (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        context_vector = jnp.matmul(attention_weights, value)

        # Optionally, project the context vector to the desired output features
        pooled_output = jnp.mean(context_vector, axis=1) # (batch_size, input_features)

        # Project to final 'features' dimension if different from input_features
        if pooled_output.shape[-1] != self.features:
            pooled_output = nn.Dense(self.features, name="final_proj")(pooled_output)

        return pooled_output

# Main network class
class AttentionCNNBiLSTMNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 128
    kernel_size: int = 9
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 256
    attention_features: int = 512 # Output feature dimension of attention pooling
    dense_dim: int = 256
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)

        # 1. CNN Layer for local feature extraction
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, new_seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)

        # 3. Self-Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation
        x = SelfAttentionPooling(features=self.attention_features)(x) # (batch, attention_features)

        # 4. Dense Layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x) # (batch, dense_dim)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Attention-Enhanced CNN-BiLSTM model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 128,
        'kernel_size': 9,
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 256,
        'attention_features': 512, # Output feature dimension of attention pooling
        'dense_dim': 256,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_AttentionCNNBiLSTM:
    """Custom network wrapper for Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM with Attention."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=128, kernel_size=9,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=256, attention_features=512, dense_dim=256, dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = AttentionCNNBiLSTMNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_features=attention_features,
            dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 128)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 256)
    attention_features = hparams.get("attention_features", 512)
    dense_dim = hparams.get("dense_dim", 256)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_AttentionCNNBiLSTM(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_features=attention_features,
        dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
